VPN с TUN может локально перехватывать D: A VPN using TUN can intercept DNS, PING and TCP locally and hide intermediate hops; take this into account when comparing measurements.
PING / RTT — время пути пакета до узла и: PING / RTT — packet round-trip time to a host and back.
Jitter — разброс задержки; Loss — доля п: Jitter — variation in delay; Loss — the proportion of lost packets.
DNS — система преобразования имён сайтов: DNS — the system that translates site names into IP addresses.
IP / IPv4 / IPv6 — адрес узла и две верс: IP / IPv4 / IPv6 — a host address and two versions of the Internet protocol.
TCP — протокол с подтверждением доставки: TCP confirms delivery; UDP sends packets without a delivery guarantee.
TLS — шифрование и проверка сертификата: TLS — encryption and certificate verification for a connection.
PID — a process identifier in the operating system.
VPN / TUN — защищённый туннель и виртуал: VPN / TUN — a protected tunnel and a virtual network interface.
MTR — непрерывная проверка маршрута; HOP: MTR — continuous route measurement; HOP — an intermediate node.
ASN / GeoIP — номер автономной сети и пр: ASN / GeoIP — an autonomous system number and approximate IP location.
Bufferbloat — рост задержки из-за очеред: Bufferbloat — increased latency from queues under load.
MTU — максимальный размер пакета; DF — з: MTU — maximum packet size; DF — the IPv4 do-not-fragment flag.
NAT — преобразование сетевых адресов меж: NAT — translation of network addresses between a local network and the Internet.

Проверяет допустимый размер пакета без ф: Probes the packet size without fragmentation to help diagnose VPN and website problems.
Хранит события диагностики и активность: Records diagnostic events and UDP port activity to correlate failures with time.
Сохраняет отчёт или пакет для техподдерж: Saves a report or support bundle so results can be shared with a specialist.
Ниже 45 мс — отлично; 45–95 мс — приемле: Below 45 ms is excellent; 45–95 ms is playable for many games; above 95 ms delay becomes noticeable.
Ниже 5 мс — стабильно, 5–15 мс — умеренн: Below 5 ms is stable, 5–15 ms is moderate, and above 15 ms means noticeable spikes.
0% — отлично, до 1,5% — единичные потери: 0% is excellent, up to 1.5% means occasional loss, above 1.5% is a problem; even occasional loss can affect voice.
A+ и A означают малый рост пинга под наг: A+ and A mean a small latency increase under load; B is moderate, C noticeable, D and F severe. The grade depends on latency increase.
До 50 мс — быстро, 50–120 мс — приемлемо: Under 50 ms is fast, 50–120 ms acceptable; above 120 ms or a closed port needs attention.
Действующий сертификат — защищено; срок: A valid certificate indicates protection; fewer than 14 days remaining is a warning; certificate errors need investigation. Certificates are usually issued for domain names, so checking a bare IP may cause a mismatch; some certificates include an IP address.
Локальный перехват может дать PING и TCP: Local interception can make PING and TCP appear around 0.5–1 ms; the tunnel hides hops and can shorten the trace to 1–2 hops. Inspect TLS handshake latency or compare with a test without VPN.
Время пути пакета до узла и обратно; вли: Round-trip time to a host and back; affects responsiveness.
Разброс задержки; высокие значения вызыв: Variation in delay; high values cause stutter and voice disruption.
Доля потерянных пакетов; вызывает рывки: Proportion of lost packets; causes stutter and audio gaps.
Преобразует имя сайта в IP; влияет на на: Translates a site name to an IP; affects connection setup.
Адрес устройства и версии протокола; опр: A device address and protocol versions; determine where traffic goes.
Протокол с подтверждением доставки; испо: A delivery-confirming protocol used by websites and many services.
Передаёт пакеты без подтверждения; часто: Sends packets without delivery confirmation; often used by games and voice.
Шифрует соединение и проверяет сертифика: Encrypts connections and verifies website certificates to protect data.
Числовой идентификатор процесса; помогае: Numeric process identifier; helps identify an application with network activity.
Сокет описывает сетевое соединение, порт: A socket describes a network connection; a port identifies a service or application channel.
VPN создаёт туннель, TUN — виртуальный и: VPN creates a tunnel and TUN is a virtual interface; they change routing and visible measurements.
Повторно измеряет маршрут; помогает найт: Repeatedly measures a route to help locate latency or loss.
Промежуточное устройство на пути пакета;: An intermediate device along the packet path; its measurements help inspect the route.
ASN обозначает сеть оператора, GeoIP при: ASN identifies an operator network; GeoIP estimates an address location.
Рост задержки из-за очередей при загрузк: Latency growth from queues under load; harms games and voice.
Максимальный размер пакета на пути; неве: Maximum packet size along a path; a wrong value can disrupt connections.
Флаг IPv4, запрещающий делить пакет; пом: An IPv4 flag preventing fragmentation; helps find a suitable MTU.
Преобразование адресов локальной сети; с: Local address translation; strict NAT can interfere with voice and P2P.
Кто виноват: дом, провайдер или сервер: Where is the problem: home, provider or server?
Если задержка или потери начинаются на п: If latency or loss starts at the first hop (for example 192.168.x.x or 10.x.x.x) and persists through the destination, check Wi-Fi, the router and cable. A hop may rate-limit ICMP responses: loss only at that hop does not prove a fault. With VPN/TUN or a direct provider cable the first hop can be a virtual or provider gateway.
Если первый узел стабилен: If the first hop is stable
Рост задержки и сквозные потери, начинаю: Latency growth and persistent loss starting at hops 2–4 can indicate a provider network issue; save the report for support. If the route is stable and only the final hops have problems, the backbone or destination service may be overloaded. These are clues, not a definitive diagnosis.
Установленное TCP-соединение; внешний ад: An established TCP connection; its external address is usually a suitable diagnostic target.
Сокет ожидает входящих подключений; акти: The socket waits for incoming connections; it has no active exchange with an external server.
TCP пытается установить соединение. Длит: TCP is attempting to connect. A prolonged state may indicate a closed port, unreachable server or firewall filtering.
Технические состояния при закрытии TCP-с: TCP connection-closing states; generally unsuitable for measuring the current connection.
UDP не устанавливает TCP-сессию. Часть с: UDP has no TCP connection state. Some sockets show only a local port and no server; choose one with an external IP. The main list does not show a state: external sockets are labelled “🎮 UDP · address:port (Game / Voice)”, local ones “(Local)”.
Потери 100% на промежуточном узле — это: Does 100% loss at an intermediate hop mean a failure?
Не обязательно: маршрутизатор может огра: Not necessarily: a router can rate-limit ICMP replies. If the destination responds without loss, isolated intermediate timeouts do not prove traffic loss. Look for loss that persists through the destination.
Почему не виден игровой сервер?: Why is the game server missing?
Внешний сокет может появиться только при: An external socket may appear only while traffic is active in a lobby or match. Minimize the game and select the circular-arrow button “Refresh process and network connection list”, then select the process again. Windows can hide a UDP remote address.
Окно запускает проверку известных игр, и: The window scans known games, selects an external UDP socket and measures ping with five probes. A found UDP endpoint is selected for diagnostics; a local UDP socket without a remote address may trigger header capture. If no server is found, the app explains why. “Check again” repeats the scan; optional monitoring checks every 8 seconds.
Почему TLS не проходит по IP?: Why can TLS fail for an IP address?
Сертификат обычно выпущен на доменное им: Certificates are usually issued for domain names, so IP verification may fail with a mismatch. Exceptions exist: some certificates include IP addresses. Check the service domain name.
Обычные проверки доступности, ping, DNS,: Ordinary reachability, ping, DNS, route and TLS checks run without UAC when permitted by the system and network. Changing DNS/MTU, resetting the network stack and managing an adapter generally require elevation on Windows. Inspecting or terminating protected processes can be restricted; raw-socket UDP header capture requires administrator rights.
Диагностика обращается к выбранной цели: Diagnostics contact the selected target and DNS resolvers; quality and Bufferbloat tests use Cloudflare and an OVH download fallback; NAT uses Google and Cloudflare STUN. Public IP and GeoIP lookups use ipify, ip-api, ipwho.is, and also icanhazip and ifconfig.me; the GeoHide window contacts geohide.ru and the HetrixTools status page. Automatic monitors repeat probes.
NetVision не отправляет телеметрию разра: NetVision does not send telemetry to the developer. During deep UDP discovery WinSock receives raw packets, but the app parses and retains only headers and counters, not passwords, messages or files. External services see your public IP when contacted; tests may download and upload test data.
«Экспорт отчёта» сохраняет диагностику и: “Export report” saves diagnostics and UDP events: target, local and public IPs, interfaces, MAC addresses, computer name, DNS, routes, results and errors. Proxy credentials are removed. A “Support bundle” can additionally include Windows and app versions, journal, measurements, selected process (name, PID, addresses and ports) and history.
В пакете для техподдержки по умолчанию в: The support bundle enables masking of IP, MAC, computer name and SSID by default, and sections can be selected. Ordinary report export does not anonymize the entire report. Review the file before publishing: adapter and process names, addresses, routes and other sensitive data may remain.
